## Install the ecosystem {#sec-install}

*animovement* is distributed through
[our r-universe](https://animovement.r-universe.dev). Installing the `animovement`
metapackage pulls in the whole ecosystem:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
install.packages(
  "animovement",
  repos = c(
    "https://animovement.r-universe.dev",
    "https://cloud.r-project.org" # <1>
  )
)
```
:::


1. The second repository (CRAN) is there so that dependencies which don't live on r-universe are found too. Once the metapackage is installed you can get that repository pair back at any time with `animovement_repos()`, which is what the other install helpers use by default.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Only need one piece?
Every package installs the same way — just swap `"animovement"` for the
individual package name, for example `"aniread"`. See
[Packages](../packages/index.qmd) for what each one does.
:::

## Load it {#sec-load}

Like the tidyverse, `library(animovement)` attaches the core packages in one
call and tells you what you got:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(animovement)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
#> -- Attaching packages -------------------------------- animovement 0.8.0.9001 --
#> v anicore    0.8.0.9001     v anicheck   0.3.0.9001
#> v aniread    0.7.0.9001     v animetric  0.5.0.9001
#> v anispace   0.3.0.9001     v anivis     0.2.1.9000
#> v aniprocess 0.5.0.9001
```


:::
:::


That's the metapackage plus the 7 working
packages, one per stage of the workflow:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
animovement_packages()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
#> [1] "anicore"     "aniread"     "anispace"    "aniprocess"  "anicheck"   
#> [6] "animetric"   "anivis"      "animovement"
```


:::
:::


From here on, the guides assume you've run `library(animovement)`.

## Optional packages {#sec-suggested}

Some functions need a package that isn't installed by default. See which packages are suggested with:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
animovement_show_suggested()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
#> -- Suggested packages for animovement ecosystem --------------------------------
#> animovement: circular, signal
#> aniread: arrow, rhdf5, xml2, c3dr
#> aniprocess: signal, stinepack
#> animetric: sf
```


:::
:::


You don't have to install these up front. When a function needs one it will
say so and offer to install it there and then:

```r
read_sleap(get_sample_data("sleap"))
#> Downloading sleap data...
#> ℹ The package "rhdf5" is required for reading HDF5 files,
#> ✖ Would you like to install it?
#>
#> 1: Yes
#> 2: No
```

Answer `1` and it installs and carries on with what you asked for without needing to
restart or re-run. To get them all in one go instead:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
animovement_install_suggested()
```
:::


::: {.callout-note}
## HDF5 exports need `rhdf5`
The samples used in these guides are SLEAP and DeepLabCut HDF5 files, so
`rhdf5` is the one you're most likely to meet first. It comes from
Bioconductor rather than CRAN, so `install.packages("rhdf5")` won't find it —
use the prompt above when you encounter it, or `animovement_install_suggested()`.
:::

## Update packages {#sec-update}

The ecosystem is under active development. To update every *animovement*
package at once:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
animovement_update()
```
:::
